aha: Falling things roll off round tops, left first: the first object down the shaft rolls left into the pit, so the stone must go first to fill it; then the pearl rolls right onto the gate.
deadlocks: Pushing the pearl into the shaft first: it rolls left into the pit and is stuck between walls forever.
Then dropping the stone too: it lands on the gate and seals it.
